A3_S2_D1: ^Noelle: So these Monsteratops… Were they the ones hanging around near the waterfall site?
^Chione: Yes! They hang around our settlement more often than other creatures, who make their homes in the outer forests.
^Narrator: Chione advises that you look around the area and ask the other creatures here if they've seen anything.
^Narrator: You feel a little nervous at the idea, since you haven’t spoken to another creature other than Amelia so far.
^Narrator: But since your dragon friend is here, it should be fine.
^Chione: I’ll stick around here and check the foliage for tracks, first. Just holler if you need me!
A3_S2_D2: ^Narrator: The creature in front of you boasts of an impressive size. You take a moment to figure out how to start the conversation, before noticing that something’s tangled in its wings.
^Noelle: Um… Would you like help with that?
^Dragonfly: Oh, sure! I was just gonna break it off, but this’ll save the little ones the trouble of collecting new vines.
^Narrator: The dragonfly finally steps back to take a proper look at you, then Amelia, before humming with intrigue.
^Dragonfly: Oh… you must be visiting the Viridi.
^Heli: Well, nice to meet you! I’m Heli, one of the locals that comes and goes delivering items, since I’ve got—
^Narrator: He flaps his wings. The vine tangled in it flops with the motion.

^Heli: —These. Sometimes, young creatures want to experience flying over the island, so they make makeshift harnesses that are a little hard to take off without thumbs. So I just break them if they get tangled.
^Narrator: Amelia scrutinizes Heli, raising herself into a bipedal position before she hops and chomps through the vine on the creature’s wings.
^Narrator: It falls off cleanly. Amelia lands on the grass with a light hop.
^Narrator: After you explain the case of the missing calf, Heli reports that while he's been picking up a lot of stray after the storm a few days ago, he hasn't spotted a monsteratops.
^Noelle: It’s alright. Thanks for letting us know.
^Heli: I’d take you on a quick spin to look, but it’d be dangerous if an untrained humanoid fell from that height.
^Heli: But rest assured! I’ll let the Viridi know if I spot him. They’re pretty well-known for their ties to the land, after all.
A3_S2_D3: ^Narrator: You and Amelia come across what looks like a trio of… beetles?
^Narrator: They’re moving around twigs and leaves of all sorts, almost like a construction site.
^Narrator: One of the beetles notice you.
^Narrator: Amelia facepalms. At the back of your mind, you wonder just how many other human-like behaviors she has.
^Noelle: Hello… Do you need us to help you move the twigs?
^Narrator: The twigs they have are all indeed snapped and thin. Probably not the best for building structures of any kind.
^Noelle: Alright, we’ll get you some wood.
A3_S2_Q1_COMPLETED: ^Narrator: Would you like to finish this quest?
CompleteQuestA3S2: ^Narrator: You've found a couple of good looking sticks. The beetles seem happy with your offering.
^Noelle: Yes, actually! Have you guys seen a little monsteratops around?
^Beetle: Oh, green beetle! Green beetle, up there.
^Narrator: Beetle and Beetlette both turn and point to the right of the trees, which you realize has a small space for you to go through.
^Noelle: Thank you guys! We’ll go look for the Monsteratops now!
^Beetlette: Good luck to dragon friend, too!
